title: 第22章：震惊
novel_title: 穿越两界，我在80年代当倒爷
content_zh:
大姑父斜了马超一眼，好似再说，你这说的不是废话吗？

    “小超，你到底要说什么？”

    “大姑父，我要说我能弄到这些紧俏货，不要票，价格比市场低一成，不知道你那边有渠道卖出去吗？”

    “你能弄到？开什么玩笑。”

    “我把话搁在这，你真能弄来，别说比市场低一成，就是在这个基础上加价两成，我也能给你卖出去。”

    “你这侄子脑壳是不是秀逗了。”

    “小超，这话别乱说。”

    “大姑，我没开玩笑。”

    “你哪里来的路子，那么多有能耐的人都弄不到紧俏货，行了，一会就在家吃饭，吃完饭了你早些回去。”

    “大姑，大姑父，我出去一趟。”

    “你这孩子咋还走了呢。”

    “让他去吧，估计是受啥刺激了。”
content_en:
The eldest uncle glanced sideways at Ma Chao, as if to say, aren't you talking nonsense?

    "Xiaochao, what exactly are you going to say?"

    "Uncle, I want to say that I can get these in-demand goods without tickets, and the price is 10% lower than the market. I wonder if you have channels to sell them?"

    "You can get it? Are you kidding me?"

    "I'll leave it at that. If you can really get it, let alone 10% lower than the market price. Even if the price is increased by 20% on this basis, I can still sell it to you."

    "Isn't your nephew's brain showing off?"

    "Xiaochao, don't say this nonsense."

    "Auntie, I'm not joking."

    "Where did you come from? There are so many capable people who can't get the goods that are in short supply. Okay, we'll have dinner at home in a while. You go back early after dinner."

    "Auntie, uncle, I'm going out."

    "Why are you still leaving, kid?"

    "Let him go, he must have been stimulated by something."
